item_name: Failure to Complete Required In-Service Training for Personal Care Aide
lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. The protocol states the in-service training requirement on an annual basis ("a minimum of six hours of in-service training education per year"), but does not state an assessor observation/look-back window in days for this audit area.

federal_coding_rules.rule: Personal care aides require a minimum of six hours of in-service training education per year.

source.quote: Personal care aides require a minimum of six hours of in-service training education per year.

federal_coding_rules.rule: If there is no documentation of in-service training found in the personnel record, the claim will be disallowed.

source.quote: If there is no documentation of in-service training found in the personnel record, or the required number of training hours were not documented , the claim will be disallowed.
